purpose: find candidate repositories from the problem model
failure_conditions: zero queries ran
any search failure unrecorded
a candidate with no originating query edge
provenance_required: rate limit state at call time

purpose: union lanes, dedupe by immutable identity, attach eligibility ONLY
failure_conditions: lanes not unioned (D-004)
dedupe key is not a commit SHA or owner/name
eligibility collapsed into relevance
provenance_required: eligibility inputs and their source URLs

purpose: clone and read; evidence may only come from bytes actually read
failure_conditions: a fragment with no file node
a file node with no repository@commit
depth=metadata used to back a claim (S06)
provenance_required: the exact command that read it

purpose: issues, PRs and commits as historical evidence; distance classes, never counts
failure_conditions: a count used as a relevance signal (D-002)
an event with no permalink

purpose: score RELEVANCE separately from eligibility; max() not sum()
failure_conditions: eligibility and relevance in one field
evidence summed rather than max()
relevance without a backing fragment or event
provenance_required: which fragment or event produced each evidence level

purpose: combine evidence into a proposed answer, BLIND to the contrarian — the objections do not exist yet (A51); AI interprets, never discovers
failure_conditions: contrarian.jsonl or adjudication.json existed when the synthesis input snapshot was taken (A51)
no SYNTHESIZER role declared with model/version/prompt-hash/config-hash
claims[] missing, or a claim with no evidence-node cites
a repository named that is absent from the run manifest
TRUTH collapsed into RELEVANCE
provenance_required: SYNTHESIZER identity (model, version, prompt hash, config hash) as a chained ROLE_DECLARED event
input snapshot snapshots/SYNTHESIZER.json with files_present at snapshot time
every claim must cite node ids in the evidence graph

purpose: independent attempt to REFUTE a FROZEN synthesis — receives the evidence and the proposed conclusion, never the synthesizer's private reasoning
cost: AI tokens — the FIRST stage permitted to spend them
failure_conditions: authored by the same declared identity as the synthesizer (A43/A48)
an objection not tied to evidence-node IDs
no COUNTERCLAIM node emitted
unaddressed objection not recorded
provenance_required: CONTRARIAN identity as a chained ROLE_DECLARED event

purpose: independent per-claim resolution against a FROZEN evidence snapshot — no model may establish the truth of its own conclusion (S25)
failure_conditions: a claim resolved without evidence-node citations (A47)
a resolution outside SUPPORTED/PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/UNDECIDABLE
adjudicator declared identity equal to the synthesizer's (A43/A48)
evidence mutated after the adjudication snapshot (A46)
a confidence score offered in place of evidence
access to another role's private reasoning
supporting evidence cited that the synthesizer never saw (A49)
provenance_required: ADJUDICATOR identity (model, version, prompt hash, config hash) as a chained ROLE_DECLARED event
immutable evidence snapshot hashes (graph byte-prefix, synthesis sha, contrarian sha)
the honest independence ladder with underlying_weights = UNKNOWN
invalidation: synthesis or contrarian artefact hash changed

purpose: state the answer WITH its three separate dimensions and a confidence the gate permits
failure_conditions: a claim adjudicated CONTRADICTED while a conclusion is emitted — a contradiction blocks promotion until resolved
a verdict emitted with no adjudication record (A52)
sufficiency gate says INSUFFICIENT and a verdict is emitted anyway (S20)
eligibility/relevance/truth not reported as three separate fields
confidence stated without the evidence coverage that justifies it

purpose: the ONLY gate through which a run may be promoted into the permanent ledger
outputs: (on pass) appended records in memory/prior-art.jsonl and sonar/evidence.jsonl
failure_conditions: a run with synthesis claims but no adjudication record was promoted (A52)
any sealed artefact's git blob changed during the run
any stage wrote outside its namespace
provenance broken between stages
UNKNOWN promoted to VERIFIED
AI invoked before deterministic tiers were exhausted
declared API budget exceeded
a candidate in the verdict that cannot be reconstructed from the manifest
provenance_required: sealed-artefact hashes before and after the run
invalidation: never — a verification record is immutable once written
